Chronology of every recorded fact about [[dream tablets]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== Blackflame ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 9''' — Information is sometimes copied into dream tablets, scrolls, books, and so forth.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 22''' — The Emperor possesses a dream tablet from an Underlord.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 22''' — A dream tablet can be used to demand punishment or request imperial assistance.}}

== Ghostwater ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 12''' — Dream tablets are stored on shelves and some have gone dark or flicker with age.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 13''' — Dream tablets are multicolored stones used to contain experiences and memories.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 13''' — Ziel watched dream tablets shifting over Lindon's head.}}

== Underlord ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 5''' — Dream tablets are small stones covered in scripts.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 5''' — Dream tablets can be made of crystal, dull rainbows, or smooth scripted river-stone.}}

== Wintersteel ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 3''' — Yerin possesses a gem-like dream tablet.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 3''' — People have experience with dream tablets.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 6''' — Dream tablets depict Sages using miraculous abilities.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 8''' — Emriss developed the ability to accurately share memories, leading to the development and widespread adoption of dream tablets.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 8''' — A dream tablet is a scripted river stone the size of a child's fist.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 8''' — Dream tablets are more common than paper for leaving behind techniques.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 9''' — A dream tablet is used for inheritances.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 24''' — Memories of advancements to Overlord are hard to store in a dream tablet.}}
